title: Hybrid SAT Routing
tagline: Compares three clause-to-solver strategies and one fallback scheduler across increasing formula size.

curves.label: CDCL Core+Restart
curves.code: for (let t=0;t<restarts;t++){ runCDCL(); if(conflicts>limit) restart(); if(solved) break; }
curves.name: CDCL Core+Restart

curves.label: DPLL With Unit Propagation
curves.code: function dpll(){ unitPropagate(); if(contradiction) backtrack(); chooseVar(); return dpll()||dpll(); }
curves.name: DPLL With Unit Propagation

curves.label: CDCL + Clause Database Reduction
curves.code: while(!solved){ propagate(); if(conflict){ learnClause(); if(dbSize>cap) reduceDB(); backjump(); } }
curves.name: CDCL + Clause Database Reduction

curves.label: Portfolio Micro-Schedules
curves.code: for (solver of portfolio){ runTimeSlice(solver, tSlice(n)); if(solver.solved) return; } fallbackGreedyPick();
curves.name: Portfolio Micro-Schedules
